posts.title: Slideshow: How many years does each job really need?
posts.caption:
How many years does each job really need? 🪜 Save this for your next switch 📌

Typical years in Indian banking and sales:
Sales Officer 0–2
Relationship Manager 2–6
Senior RM 5–10
Area Sales Manager 5–10
Branch Manager 7–14
Cluster Head 12–20
Regional Head 15–25

Typical, not a rule: it varies by company, and the years in the job ad always win. Job Finder shows them on every job card: link in bio.
